11.8 The Company’s Open Reporting Policy

Company’s Open Reporting System Policy

ALL shore and vessel employees regardless of rank may choose to report anonymously any non-
compliance with the Environmental Compliance Program (ECP), Environment Management System (EMS)
and/or other Marine Environmental Protection requirements via Company's Open Reporting System.
Company will guarantee protection from reprisals or victimisation from reporting such concerns. Victimisation
of any personnel who uses “Open Reporting System” platform or any attempt to deter him/her from using the
“Open Reporting System” is a serious offence and will be subjected to Company disciplinary actions or
dismissal. Other matters as below may also be reported using Open Reporting System:

Unlawful activities.

Professional or un-ethical malpractices.

Concealing serious wrongdoings or malpractices.

Actions or activities that are not in line with a legal obligation or violating any of Company policies.
Actions that may pose a danger to the health and safety of any individual.

Personal data breaches.

Any other issue that may cause damage to property or to Company's reputation.
